Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.utils

Class ThreadLocalManager

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.utils.ThreadLocalManager
public final class ThreadLocalManager extends Object
ThreadLocal memory leak prevention and management utility. Provides automatic cleanup of ThreadLocal variables to prevent memory leaks in long-running applications and thread pools.
